about: The introitus of the formulary “Immaculate Heart of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Let us approach the throne of grace with confidence, that we may obtain mercy and find grace in timely help. My heart has poured forth a noble word; I recite my works to the King. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Let us approach the throne of grace with confidence, that we may obtain mercy and find grace in timely help.
